title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
script:
Apple Intelligence is finally arriving in China with the iOS 27.3 update.
The company confirmed the news directly on its Chinese newsroom website today.
Users can access the first beta release starting on November 4th.
A full public release for the software is scheduled for this December.
The update brings specific localized features for Chinese speaking users.
This move follows reports first surfaced by the team at MacRumors.
Will you try these new tools?
